Canada.headline: TSX falls as oil rally fuels inflation concerns, gold retreat and AI funding fears hit tech
Canada.why: The close was pulled lower by several factors that the sources explicitly linked to the move: higher oil prices raising inflation worries, a retreat in gold prices, concerns over AI funding affecting technology stocks, broader energy‑inflation pressure, and a focus on retail performance.

India.label: India
India.headline: Nifty and Sensex closed modestly lower as oil prices rose and after RBI rate hike
India.why: Two factors are explicitly linked to the decline by the sources: (1) rising oil prices, noted in multiple reports; (2) the RBI’s recent rate hike, cited as the trigger for the Nifty slipping below 22,650. The finance‑minister tax comment is only an intraday rally and not tied to the close.
